committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 6 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend held flat at $131.45 versus $128.87 prior7 on the same 22 clicks, but conversions last7 are still zero, so cost per lead can't be worked out until the landing-page test starts producing qualified enquiries.

Impression share is just 10%, with 74.4% lost to rank against only 20.6% lost to budget: rank, not budget, is the binding constraint right now, so there's nothing here that changes the fixed-budget decision during the test.

CTR slipped from 3.7% to 3.2% even as impressions rose to 687 (from 601), and /free-workflow-review.html shows 7 sessions since launch with zero paid clicks logged yet in the test, too early to read anything into either number.

AI Assistant sessions rose to 4 (from 2), claude-check the top source, worth watching since this channel undercounts: Direct jumped from 7 to 36 and likely hides further AI referrals with no referrer.

actions.text: Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding, this remains open.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success, these need updating to match current site stats.
